entries.requirement_text: The validation report shall not include a check that recursively validates the report itself. Fingerprint linkage, digest linkage, check ordering, check uniqueness, report schema validation, serialization, and staging-state validation are not ordinary profile checks; they are validation-component postconditions enforced during report finalization before promotion.

entries.requirement_text: Report finalization is a deterministic ordered write operation that occurs after all Phase 1 and Phase 2 checks are recorded. Finalization shall proceed in this exact order: (a) calculate the proposed overall_status as pass only when every required Phase 1 and Phase 2 check has status passed, otherwise fail; (b) construct in memory a proposed final validation report carrying the proposed overall_status, the canonical request_fingerprint, and the expected repository_content_digest; (c) construct in memory a proposed final staging-state representation carrying validation_completed equal to true, validation_overall_status equal to the proposed overall_status, the canonical request_fingerprint, and the expected repository_content_digest (the same digest recorded in the staging-state record and computed during the output.repository-digest-match check); (d) validate the proposed staging-state representation against the product.staging-state schema in memory without writing it, verifying that its request_fingerprint matches the canonical request fingerprint and its repository_content_digest matches the expected digest; (e) validate the proposed validation report against the validation-report schema in memory, verifying that the checks array contains exactly one entry per profile check_id in ascending order-number order with no missing or duplicate entries; (f) serialize and write the finalized validation report atomically to transaction/validation-report.json; (g) serialize and write the finalized staging-state record atomically to transaction/staging-state.json; and (h) re-read or otherwise verify that the two durable records are mutually consistent, confirming they share the same request_fingerprint and repository_content_digest and that the staging-state validation_completed and validation_overall_status agree with the completed validation result. Promotion is permitted only when steps (a) through (h) all succeed.

entries.requirement_text: Report finalization shall complete before promotion begins. Promotion must not proceed unless both the finalized validation report and the finalized staging-state record are durably written and verified mutually consistent, and the report overall_status is pass. The staging-state record must not claim validation_completed equal to true before the validation report has been successfully serialized, written, and consistency-verified. The initializer must not begin promotion when only one of the two records has been durably written. Any finalization failure (staging-state schema validation failure, fingerprint mismatch, digest mismatch, validation-status mismatch, linkage mismatch, ordering violation, report schema validation failure, serialization error, or failure of the final consistency verification) shall prevent promotion, shall be recorded as a pre-promotion failure, and shall preserve the staging transaction root for diagnostics.

entries.requirement_text: The staging-state record shall be validated during report finalization using the following stable failure codes: staging-state-invalid-schema when the record does not conform to the product.staging-state schema; staging-state-fingerprint-mismatch when the request_fingerprint in the staging-state record does not match the canonical request fingerprint; staging-state-digest-mismatch when the repository_content_digest in the staging-state record does not match the expected digest; staging-state-validation-status-mismatch when the validation_completed or validation_overall_status fields in the staging-state record disagree with the completed validation result. Any of these failures shall prevent promotion.
